info.title: Sommelier dashboard API
info.description: Authenticated by a session cookie. The tenant is resolved from a `memberships` row for the signed-in user and never from request input, so a tenant id in a body, query or header is ignored.

get.description:
Returns the name of the route surface that handled the request. It exists so a caller - or a test - can prove *which* application answered, rather than only that something did. Carries no tenant, user or catalogue data.

No capability required. Surface marker. Reports which app answered and nothing else - no tenant, no user, no data. P0-46 uses it to prove the two surfaces are distinct.

401.description: The request failed. `code` is stable; `message` is for a human.

403.description: The request failed. `code` is stable; `message` is for a human.

get.summary: The resolved tenant and role for this request
get.description:
Reports what the server decided the request is scoped to. The tenant comes from a `memberships` row for the authenticated user and never from request input; the role comes from that same row, so a user who is EDITOR on one winery and OWNER on another gets the right one for the winery in play.

Requires the `catalog:read` capability.

200.description: The resolved tenant and role for this request

401.description: The request failed. `code` is stable; `message` is for a human.

403.description: The request failed. `code` is stable; `message` is for a human.

get.summary: The caller and the wineries they belong to
get.description:
Authenticated, but resolved before a tenant is chosen - a user who belongs to several wineries cannot pick one from a list they are not allowed to fetch. The memberships returned are scoped by Row Level Security to the caller, so this cannot be used to enumerate anybody else. Send the chosen tenant back on subsequent requests in the active-tenant header.

No capability required. Authenticated but pre-tenant, by necessity: a user with several memberships cannot choose from a list they are not allowed to fetch. It returns only the caller's own identity and memberships, which RLS scopes to them (P0-47).

200.description: The caller and the wineries they belong to

info.title: Sommelier widget API
info.description: Public, called from sellers’ own sites. Authenticated by origin-bound tokens rather than cookies; this surface accepts no credentials.
